title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A cache hit is free again
summary: Keying the cache on the text itself meant reading and hashing the document on every request. A hit is back to 0.00013 ms from 0.037 ms, and a reopened file is still caught.

highlights.title: The document is not read on a hit
highlights.description: Measured over the 60 largest files of a real Android project, a cache hit went from 0.00013 ms to 0.037 ms in the previous release. It is back where it was.

highlights.title: Correctness kept
highlights.description: The same object at the same version is necessarily the same text, since the version is bumped on every change. The text is hashed only when the object differs, which is exactly the reopened file the fingerprint was added for.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: The check that proves it, two texts of exactly 64 characters at the same path and version, still holds.
The sweep over a real project of 3187 files reports that no cache answers differently warm than cold.
